messages.subject: CMC done - directions and trial window
messages.plaintextBody:
Geoffrey,

The CMC went well. Directions attached. Headlines: disclosure by 5 June (Helmsworth must produce their build and bearing-spec records - very helpful for us), expert reports exchanged by 31 July, witness statements by 17 July, and a 5-day trial in a window from 9 November. The single-joint-expert question is parked to the PTR.

Next step is the Part 36 offer Harriet recommended (~£820k). I'll prepare it for your approval.

Kind regards,
Tom

Tom Gallagher | Associate

T +44 (0)20 7946 0500
